02 / Our unexpected story

It started with a hello.

Cyprus

Who would have thought? Back in Cyprus, we didn't always get along. Sometimes you didn't even like having me around, and the thought of us being together never crossed my mind.

Back in Congo

After I flew back to Congo, I decided to call everyone from the choir. Somehow, calling you felt harder than it should have. But I did it anyway. What was meant to be a simple hello became a conversation that lasted much longer than I expected.

July 2024

And from there, things slowly became what they are today. Of all the calls I made, I never imagined that yours would become such a meaningful part of my life.

Sometimes the most beautiful chapters begin without us even knowing we are turning a page.

04 / From my heart

My letter to you.

Happy birthday, my love. ❤️

Today is more than just the day you were born. It's the day God allowed a beautiful soul to come into this world, and sometimes I like to believe that He already knew that, somewhere along the journey of life, there would be a man like me who would need someone like you.

There is so much I could say about the woman you are, your personality, your heart, and all those little things that make you uniquely you. You deserve the best and nothing less. Even on the days when you struggle to see how amazing you are, I wish you could see yourself through my eyes. Perhaps then you would understand why you are so special to me.

Today, more than anything, I wish distance didn't exist. I wish I could hold you in my arms, look into your beautiful eyes, kiss your forehead, and tell you how much I love you and how grateful I am to have you in my life.

Thank you for being yourself. Thank you for being part of my story and for inspiring me to become a better version of myself.

My love, I cannot promise you a life without difficulties, misunderstandings or imperfections. But I want to be someone with whom you never have to pretend to be okay when you're not. Someone with whom you can be vulnerable without fear.

I want you to know that your voice matters, your feelings are valid, no matter how small or overwhelming they may seem, and your heart deserves to be treated with tenderness.

Even when I am not physically beside you, please remember that distance can separate our bodies, but it doesn't have to separate our hearts.

I want to celebrate your victories, comfort you through your disappointments, support your dreams, and remind you of your worth whenever life makes you forget it. I want to be there not only for your beautiful days but also for those days when you feel like everything is falling apart.

Above all, my prayers for you are found in these scriptures:

❤️ Proverbs 9:4 — May you always seek wisdom and walk in God's understanding.

❤️ Psalm 139:14 — May you never forget that you are fearfully and wonderfully made.

❤️ Psalm 20:4 — May God grant you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.

May this new chapter of your life bring you closer to God, closer to your dreams, and closer to the woman you aspire to become. May He protect you, guide your footsteps, heal everything you silently struggle with, and bless you beyond what your heart can imagine.

May you have countless reasons to testify of His goodness and faithfulness in your life.

I love you so much, and I cannot wait for the day when distance will no longer be an obstacle. The day when celebrating your birthday, your achievements, and every little special moment together will no longer be something we only dream about.

I look forward to the ordinary days too, because sometimes the greatest happiness is simply being beside the person you love, doing nothing extraordinary.

Aaaah, mon amour, je laisse seulement... 🥹❤️

I thought I would stop here, but how can I when there is still so much in my heart that words cannot express?

I met you at a time when I still carried wounds that refused to heal. Yet you never made me feel that those wounds made me any less worthy of love. You made me feel that even the broken parts of me deserved affection and understanding.

With you, I have learned that vulnerability is not weakness, that being loved doesn't require being perfect, and that sometimes the most beautiful form of love is when someone sees the parts of you that you struggle to accept and still chooses to embrace you.

You have taught me that even scars can be loved, and that a heart doesn't have to be completely healed before it deserves to be held gently.

If I could write a book about my life, you would be one of my favourite chapters. And if I had to replace the word love with a name, perhaps yours would be the first that comes to my mind.

Not because you are perfect, but because of what your presence has meant to me.

I know things between us will not always be perfect. There will be days when we misunderstand each other, days when loving each other requires more patience, forgiveness and understanding. But none of that takes away the beautiful things I see in you or the gratitude I carry in my heart for having met you.

Despite the distance, our imperfections and everything life brings our way, I remain grateful that our paths crossed.

I know you might not get to enjoy your birthday to the fullest, but remember that somewhere in this world, there is a man who is celebrating your existence with all his heart, thanking God for your life and wishing he could be there to make your day unforgettable.

And that man is me, your watermelon. 🍉❤️

If I had one wish today, it would be to wake up beside you, hold you close, and spend the entire day reminding you how precious you are to me.

Thank you for existing. Thank you for being the woman you are. Thank you for the memories, the laughter, the lessons, and even the little moments you probably don't remember but that mean so much to me.

If there is one thing I want you to carry with you into this new chapter of your life, it is the certainty that you matter, that you are precious, that you are worthy of love, and that someone somewhere is genuinely praying for your happiness.

May God bless every chapter of your life, including the ones I pray we will get to write together.

Happy birthday, my beautiful woman, my love, my coconut head. 😂❤️

May this new age be as beautiful as your soul, as extraordinary as your heart, and as precious as the memories we have yet to create.

I love you deeply, more than my words can express and more than the distance between us could ever measure.

Joyeux anniversaire, mon amour. ❤️

Nakupenda sana, mpenzi wangu. ❤️

With all my love, Your watermelon. 🍉❤️
